prompt: Which class makes HTTP requests using Java's built-in client (Java 11+)?
explanation: java.net.http.HttpClient (Java 11) provides a fluent API: HttpClient.newHttpClient().send(request, BodyHandlers.ofString()). Supports both synchronous (send) and asynchronous (sendAsync) requests, HTTP/2, and WebSockets. java.net.URL is the older approach.
